name: techservice-hub
description: TechService Hub — two-founder IT services platform (Next.js + Express + Neon PostgreSQL + Prisma + Firebase Auth)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tsh/shared && npm run build -w @tsh/api && npm run build -w @tsh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tsh/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tsh/api && npm run typecheck -w @tsh/web
scripts.lint: eslint packages/shared apps/api && npm run lint -w @tsh/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tsh/shared && npm run test -w @tsh/api
